H6GA01109.name: Jim Kingston
H6GA01109.bio: Built his career in the insurance industry, working with families and small businesses across Georgia.

positions.stance: Will "always fight to lower taxes across the board" and supports a simpler, fairer tax code.
Supports regular order in appropriations, a return to balanced budgets, and holding agencies accountable for every taxpayer dollar.
Supports work requirements for able-bodied adults and "no Medicaid handouts to illegal aliens."
Will fight to preserve Medicare for seniors while pursuing reforms for long-term solvency, including rooting out waste, fraud and abuse.
Supports more border enforcement resources against cartels and traffickers and a merit-based legal immigration policy.

H2GA02031.name: Sanford Bishop
H2GA02031.bio: U.S. Representative for Georgia's Second Congressional District, serving his sixteenth term and a senior member of the House Appropriations Committee.

positions.stance: Committed to helping Georgia's farmers and ranchers prosper, including strong federal disaster assistance, rural broadband, and reducing or eliminating the estate tax.
Supports resources for law enforcement and first responders, prevention programs for at-risk youth, and education and job training for prison inmates.
Fights to make sure service members have "the best weapons, equipment, materials, and support for their families."
Calls rebuilding the district's economy his top priority, supporting job creation, tax relief for families and companies, eliminating the estate tax, and small business lending.
Supports making schools and universities accessible and affordable, including Pell Grant increases, aid to prevent teacher layoffs, and investment in HBCUs and community colleges.

H6GA01182.name: Matt Day
H6GA01182.bio: Founder of construction labor companies Glaziers on Demand and Glazier Nation, raised in a farming and glass-business family in Southeast Georgia.

positions.stance: Wants to "ERADICATE criminal cartels and drugs."
Says he "fights pollutions with Farmers using Nature's Natural Process."
"Brain Chips should only be used to improve people who are in a serious health crisis."
Says pharmacy benefit managers "are Bankrupting America's Healthcare System."
"America must always have the Strongest Military, while simultaneously searching for peace."

H4GA03126.name: Brian Jack
H4GA03126.bio: Former aide who served in President Trump's White House; a sixth-generation Georgian from Fayette County.

positions.stance: Calls for finishing the border wall, funding ICE and Border Patrol, deporting criminal illegal immigrants, and reforming immigration laws to prioritize working-class Americans.
Supports lowering taxes and expanding Trump's middle-class tax cuts, reducing spending toward a balanced budget, and unleashing American oil and natural gas.
Pledges to work with Jim Jordan to "end the weaponization of our justice system."
Supports "clear, common-sense guidelines for blockchain technology" to create jobs, protect consumers, and keep America the leader in financial services.

H4GA03100.name: Maura Keller
H4GA03100.bio: U.S. Army veteran of 26 years who rose to Lieutenant Colonel and later worked as a health care worker at the Atlanta VA.

positions.stance: "100% committed to raising the minimum wage," protecting labor rights, investing in affordable housing, and fixing Social Security and student loan relief.
Stands with farmers against corporate land grabs and harmful deregulation, and will back the Agricultural Right to Repair Act on her first day.
Will vote to restore Medicare subsidies and close the insurance gap; supports prescription drug caps and more coverage for children and seniors.
Will prioritize easier access to VA care, food security programs, subsidized housing, and telehealth and local clinics for rural veterans.
Will demand Social Security payments that keep pace with inflation and work across the aisle on reform to keep the program solvent.

H6GA04129.name: Hank Johnson
H6GA04129.bio: U.S. Representative for Georgia's Fourth Congressional District since 2007 and a senior member of the House Judiciary Committee.

positions.stance: Advocates "diplomacy first" while ensuring U.S. forces are fully equipped and veterans receive the best possible support.
Backs his FAIR Act to restore consumers' right to go to court, plus more funding and oversight for the Consumer Product Safety Commission.
Believes "high-quality education should be a right, not a privilege"; supports more public school funding, higher teacher pay, and opposes cuts to the Education Department.
Committed to a clean, sustainable energy future through renewable energy investment, stronger infrastructure, and affordable, reliable power for all.
Supports the Affordable Care Act and access to affordable, quality care, and strongly opposes Medicaid cuts.

H6GA04194.name: James Duffe
H6GA04194.bio: U.S. Navy veteran who served in nuclear submarine service and later built a career in business.

positions.stance: Supports replacing the federal income tax with the FairTax, a single national consumption tax with a family rebate, and abolishing the IRS.
Supports law enforcement, first responders, crime victims, and policies that restore accountability, starting with strong families and communities.
Will fight to cut "crushing regulations that make it harder to hire, grow, invest, and compete."
Supports education that prepares students for jobs, skilled trades, military service, business ownership, college, and citizenship.
Will fight for "transparency, accountability, fiscal discipline, and constitutional limits on federal power."

H0GA05301.name: Nikema Williams
H0GA05301.bio: U.S. Representative for Georgia's Fifth Congressional District and former Georgia State Senator.

positions.stance: Backs bills to stop hedge-fund ownership of single-family homes, fund critical home repairs, and help families pass homes down without a formal deed.
Fighting to fund women's health research and community-based care; says "Reproductive rights are human rights."
Fighting for an economy where every family has "a fair shot at building lasting wealth," including expanded capital access for minority-owned businesses.
Supports the Minority Entrepreneurship Grant Program Act, more contracting opportunities, and protecting SBA programs.
Opposes cuts to the Department of Education, supports public schools and TRIO programs, and backs SNAP access for college students.
"I will report to my constituents via my podcast every week to discuss issues in plain terms."
Describes the Federal Reserve's FedNow system as a tracking program that would eliminate cash nationwide.
Focused on creating awareness about what he calls poison in the food supply.
"If I am elected, I promise I will own no stock, believing it as a conflict of interest."
"I will not take any contributions from any company, only individuals."

H8GA06393.name: Lucy McBath
H8GA06393.bio: Congresswoman and former Delta Air Lines employee of 30 years who later worked for Everytown for Gun Safety and Moms Demand Action.

positions.stance: A "staunch supporter of expanding protections" for LGBTQ+ people; fought to pass the Equality Act barring discrimination in workplaces, housing, and credit.
Opposed defunding Planned Parenthood; says communities deserve access to cancer screening, contraceptives, and family planning services.
Supports funding to modernize roads, airports, and transit and to expand safe drinking water and high-speed internet.
Strongly disagrees with Citizens United, opposes dark money, and will support legislation increasing campaign finance transparency.
Calls climate change "an existential threat" and supports investments in green infrastructure and helping families shift to clean energy.

H6GA06181.name: Kevin Martin
H6GA06181.bio: Corporate controller for 30 years and a fifth-generation resident of Georgia's 6th District.

positions.stance: Send education money back to Georgia "without the federal strings" and help the district raise up its lowest-performing schools.
Make federal student aid work for shorter technical programs and fund career and technical education "like it matters."
Pass an actual budget through regular order, fund core obligations first, and make other programs justify themselves before new appropriations.
Open unused federal land for building, give mortgage terms a real hearing, and keep lending standards honest.
"A full-time wage should clear the cost of living and keep pace with inflation" without compressing the career ladder.

H0GA07273.name: Rich McCormick
H0GA07273.bio: U.S. Congressman, emergency room physician, and former Marine helicopter pilot and Navy Commander.

positions.stance: "Put parents first, restore high standards, support local control, and make sure every student has a fair shot."
"Cut inflationary spending, lower taxes, unleash American energy, and reduce the pressure families feel every day."
"Put patients and doctors back at the center of healthcare — with more access, more transparency, and lower costs."
"Support servicemembers, invest responsibly in readiness, and keep America strong enough to deter conflict."
"Cut costly regulations, back small businesses, and make Washington serve communities again."

H6GA07221.name: Anthony Kozycki
H6GA07221.bio: Combat veteran and former Navy F/A-18 aviator, attorney, and Naval Academy graduate raised in LaGrange, Georgia.

positions.stance: Supports banning congressional stock trading through blind trusts, making Congress more transparent, and measuring leaders by results.
Focus on lowering housing, childcare, health care, and energy costs and "put working families back at the center of our economic policy."
Supports reinstating the expanded Child Tax Credit, making childcare tax-deductible, and expanding the employer childcare credit.
Will fight to restore and make permanent ACA premium tax credits, protect pre-existing condition coverage, and let the government negotiate drug prices.
Opposes cutting or privatizing Social Security or raising the retirement age; supports Medicare drug price negotiation and tougher action on elder fraud.

H0GA08099.name: Austin Scott
H0GA08099.bio: Represents Georgia's 8th Congressional District; previously spent 20 years running his own small business.

positions.stance: "He supports limited government, small business job growth, a strong national defense, and a healthy agricultural economy."

H6GA08138.name: Kelly Esti
H6GA08138.bio: Navy veteran, co-owner and CFO of BroTagz Embroidery, and former member of the Hapeville Board of Zoning Appeals.

positions.stance: Would oversee federal agencies serving veterans and military communities so service members, veterans, and families "receive the support they have earned."
Calls education "a public good"; will support federal programs that expand access and push for funding that keeps learning affordable.
Will help local governments access federal grants, modernize utility systems, and ensure rural communities aren't left behind in new energy programs.
Treats health care as a public good; will strengthen federal health programs and support funding for rural clinics and hospitals.
Will secure federal funding for transportation and broadband projects; "Infrastructure should work for everyone, no matter their ZIP code."

H0GA09246.name: Andrew Clyde
H0GA09246.bio: U.S. Representative elected in 2020, Navy veteran of 28 years, and founder of the firearms business Clyde Armory.

positions.stance: Calls for repealing the excise tax on firearms and ammunition.
Calls for repealing the National Firearms Act excise tax on firearms.
Supports passing the Hearing Protection Act to deregulate suppressors, and adding short-barreled rifles and shotguns to it.
Wants to remove the federal "Sporting Purposes" test, calling it an infringement on the right to keep and bear arms.
Supports eliminating the Brady background check system, saying the FBI cannot be trusted to implement it properly.

H6GA09284.name: Caitlyn Gegan
H6GA09284.bio: Community organizer who has worked on women's rights and criminal justice reform; holds degrees from the University of Georgia and the London School of Economics.

positions.stance: Committed to fighting for a livable minimum wage, more affordable housing, and universal health care.
"I will fight for Medicare for All."
Says the very wealthy must "pay their fair share in taxes," with the revenue used for social programs that benefit everyone.
Will fight to help Congress take back its war and taxation powers and restore checks and balances.
Supports a federal AI regulatory commission and fighting data centers that take community resources; says license-plate-reader companies infringe on rights.

H6GA10183.name: Pamela DeLancy
H6GA10183.bio: Retired U.S. Army colonel after 39 years of service and a registered nurse.

positions.stance: Will work to protect and expand access to quality health care, protect veterans' earned benefits, and strengthen mental health policies.
Supports economic relief on housing and food costs and says data center expansion "cannot come at the expense of our water supply."
Committed to working with community leaders, educators, and law enforcement; says public safety "is about prevention, accountability, and partnership."
Supports comprehensive reform that strengthens border security, repairs asylum, creates a legal pathway for work, and adds oversight of enforcement.

H6GA10175.name: Houston Gaines
H6GA10175.bio: Georgia State Representative since 2019 who works with Carter Engineering, a small business in Oconee County.

positions.stance: "Deportations must continue, and the border must stay secure"; backed state laws requiring full cooperation with ICE.
Wants to invest in public safety, help law enforcement, and crack down on crime.
Says Congress should "Cut spending and cut taxes" to restore fiscal sanity.
Supports promoting American-made goods and growing American jobs rather than outsourcing manufacturing.
Supports rebuilding the military without DEI, "peace through strength," and standing with Israel.

H0GA14048.name: John Cowan
H0GA14048.bio: Neurosurgeon and small business owner from Bartow County.

positions.stance: Fix problems created by Obamacare: "lower premiums, expand choices, and put patients back in charge of their own care."
Supports tax relief for families and small businesses, investing in American workers, and strengthening domestic industries.
Require proof of citizenship to vote and secure election infrastructure: "make it easy to vote and impossible to cheat."
Preserve and protect free speech, freedom of worship, and the right to bear arms.
Ban congressional stock trading, strengthen ethics rules, and fight for term limits.

H6GA11116.name: Chris Harden
H6GA11116.bio: Attorney who has spent more than 14 years helping families navigate difficult challenges.

positions.stance: Will fight to restore and expand ACA premium tax credits and protect Medicare and Medicaid; believes "reproductive freedom is a fundamental right."
Will fight for middle-class tax relief while ensuring large corporations and the wealthiest Americans pay their fair share.
Pledged not to accept corporate PAC money; supports more transparency and closing campaign finance loopholes.
Supports policies to lower everyday costs, trade policies protecting Georgia jobs and agriculture, and raising the minimum wage.
Supports expanding access to capital for small businesses and reducing unnecessary barriers for entrepreneurs.

H2GA12121.name: Rick Allen
H2GA12121.bio: Founder of R.W. Allen & Associates, a construction company in Augusta, Georgia, which he built over about 40 years.

H6GA12080.name: Ceretta Smith
H6GA12080.bio: Former U.S. Army medic, federal employee and national union leader, and Grovetown city councilmember.

positions.stance: Plans to lower household costs, attract good-paying jobs, ensure fair wages, and invest in local economic growth in GA-12.
Supports expanding coverage, lowering out-of-pocket costs, strengthening rural clinics, and expanding mental health services.
Supports stronger transition support, cutting red tape for benefits, and expanded mental health programs for veterans.
"Every child in GA-12 deserves a great public school"; supports fair funding and better pay for educators.
Supports good local jobs, help for rural farmers, "common-sense safety" to reduce gun violence, and more mental health and youth services.

H2GA04201.name: Jonathan Chavez
H2GA04201.bio: 23-year U.S. Air Force veteran with deployments to Iraq.

positions.stance: Lower the tax burden on working families, incentivize small business growth, pursue smart deregulation, and explore fair tax options.
"Advance affordability through Medicaid expansion" and expand rural and telehealth access.
Supports safer roads and transit, EV charging where demand is real, and guaranteed broadband speeds to close the digital divide.
"Fund classrooms, partner with parents, strengthen career and technical pathways, and keep politics out of the basics."
Supports term limits, faster infrastructure delivery, transparent scorecards, and a constituent-first approach.

H6GA13070.name: Jasmine Clark
H6GA13070.bio: Georgia state representative since 2018 and a college educator.

positions.stance: Will challenge Trump administration policies she calls destructive, protect Georgia jobs, and restore research funding.
Agenda includes making life affordable for Georgia families, expanding health care, and making homeownership accessible for all.
Supports lower-cost childcare and Pre-K for all, more K-12 funding, protecting HBCUs, and investing in trades and apprenticeships.
Says "Billionaires and Corporations Should Pay Their Fair Share"; supports small businesses and protecting unions.
Calls to "Stop Unconstitutional ICE Raids," restore reproductive health care, and protect LGBTQ+ rights.

H0GA14030.name: Clay Fuller
H0GA14030.bio: District Attorney for the Lookout Mountain Judicial Circuit, Air National Guard lieutenant colonel, and former White House Fellow.

positions.stance: Committed to President Trump's America First agenda to bring good-paying manufacturing jobs back to Northwest Georgia.
Supports "all efforts" by the Trump administration to remove illegal immigrants; says "Border Security is National Security."
Will fight to protect First and Second Amendment freedoms: "Our God given rights shall NOT be infringed, period."
Will work with President Trump to defeat narco-traffickers and hold criminals accountable.

H4GA14057.name: Shawn Harris
H4GA14057.bio: Retired Army Brigadier General, combat veteran, farmer, and small business owner.

positions.stance: Pledges to post every bill with how he intends to vote, hold unscreened monthly town halls, release the Epstein files, and limit House members to three terms.
Opposes Social Security privatization, supports scrapping the payroll tax cap, and wants to get Wall Street out of the housing market.
Supports bringing aerospace and defense manufacturing to Northwest Georgia, paid union apprenticeships, and tech hub grants.
Supports equal opportunities for small and medium farms, making SNAP mandatory spending protected from shutdowns, and protecting farmland from PFAS.
Supports moving Head Start to the Department of Education, protecting it from shutdowns, and restoring the Department of Education.

H2NC02287.name: Don Davis
H2NC02287.bio: U.S. Congressman since 2023, U.S. Air Force veteran, educator, former mayor, and six-term North Carolina state senator.

positions.stance: Fighting to lower prescription drug prices, make housing more affordable, and protect working families from price increases.
Working to create jobs, help small businesses grow, attract investment to rural communities, and expand workforce training.
Fighting to strengthen schools, expand early childhood education, and make college and workforce training more affordable.
Working to support rural hospitals, strengthen family farms, and expand reliable high-speed internet across eastern North Carolina.
Fighting to improve veterans' health care, reduce benefit delays, support military families, and strengthen VA services.

H4NC01137.name: Laurie Buckhout
H4NC01137.bio: Retired Army colonel, Iraq War combat commander, and business leader.

positions.stance: Will fight for lower costs and better jobs, and "to cut taxes so hardworking families can get ahead."
"Border security is national security"; will ensure Border Patrol agents have resources to keep dangerous drugs out.
Committed to cutting unnecessary regulations on Eastern North Carolina's farmers, fishermen, and seafood industries.
Will stand against those who "would punish law-abiding gun owners with additional red tape."
Committed to investing in the military to deter China, Iran, and Russia and to defend allies like Israel.
